Copeland noted that their new roles feature him playing the straight man while Cage acts as the curmudgeon, creating a completely different chemistry than their previous runs in the year 2000.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher discusses pursuing AEW World Championship
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher has made it clear that winning the AEW World Championship is a major long-term goal for his career. However, his immediate focus remains on defending his International Title in a high-stakes triple threat match against Konosuke Takeshita and Kazuchika Okada at All In. Fletcher also acknowledged massive bouts like Kenny Omega versus Will Ospreay while emphasizing that professional wrestling is all about timing and positioning. Having previously challenged Hangman Page for the world title, Fletcher ultimately envisions himself as the face and future of the promotion for decades to come.

stories.title: Speculation on Ilja Dragunov joining AEW following WWE departure
stories.tldr: Following his departure from WWE, heavy speculation suggests Ilja Dragunov could make a surprise debut for All Elite Wrestling at the upcoming All In event in London. Analysts are eyeing the Men's Casino Gauntlet match as the ideal spot for his arrival to position him immediately near the top of the card. Meanwhile, AEW International Champion Kyle Fletcher has publicly expressed his excitement about the prospect of reigniting their past rivalry.

stories.title: AEW All In 2026 match card and event coverage
stories.tldr: As AEW All In approaches this weekend at Wembley Stadium, the finalized match card features several high-profile championship bouts including Jon Moxley versus Nigel McGuinness and multiple multi-man encounters. Speculation also surrounds potential last-minute additions, while ticket distribution figures hovering around 42,000 reflect a cooling novelty and broader economic pressures compared to previous UK events.

stories.title: AEW announces TV schedule adjustments for All Out week
stories.tldr: Building on the previously announced back-to-back Dynamite and Collision tapings for All Out week, additional programming details have emerged. The September Indianapolis block will also feature a late-night countdown special and the return of the Tailgate Brawl pre-show on TNT. Furthermore, AEW has announced several new October event dates and detailed upcoming classic content additions for HBO Max.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton releases rap track with Lil Yachty
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown star Tiffany Stratton recently surprised fans by stepping into the recording booth with rapper Lil Yachty during his August 26 Twitch stream. The pair collaborated on an unexpected hip-hop track featuring Stratton delivering confident bars about her appearance, financial success, and relentless pursuit of championship gold. Incorporating her signature Tiffy Time catchphrase into the lyrics, the crossover collaboration quickly went viral across social media. While it remains unconfirmed if the song will get an official release or end up on WWE television, the impromptu session has generated significant buzz among wrestling fans.

stories.title: Logan Paul and Bron Breakker address rumors of backstage issues
stories.tldr: Former WWE talent Jonathan Coachman recently sparked a rumor claiming that Bron Breakker and Logan Paul were experiencing backstage tension and did not get along. Both wrestlers have strongly and publicly debunked these claims, with Breakker laughing off the report as clickbait during a recent backstage vlog. The two stablemates have made it clear that there is no truth to the rumors, expressing amusement at the fabricated weekly narratives.

stories.title: TKO becomes minority shareholder in DAZN streaming platform
stories.tldr: TKO Group Holdings, the parent company of WWE and UFC, has become a minority shareholder in the sports streaming platform DAZN following DAZN's acquisition of EverPass Media. EverPass was originally founded by the NFL investment arm 32 Equity and RedBird Capital Partners, with TKO having previously invested in EverPass back in 2024. As part of this new deal, TKO, RedBird, and the NFL all transition into minority stakeholders in the combined DAZN and EverPass entity. The acquisition allows DAZN to expand its commercial footprint in the United States by leveraging EverPass infrastructure for distributing live sports to bars, hotels, and restaurants.

stories.title: Natalya reflects on WWE career and Vince McMahon limiting opportunities
stories.tldr: WWE veteran Natalya recently opened up about her career, expressing frustration that former chairman Vince McMahon would have limited her current outside opportunities. She praised current leadership under Nick Khan and Triple H for allowing her to work promotions like Bloodsport, GCW, NWA, and AAA for personal growth. Additionally, Natalya discussed her future aspirations behind the scenes in WWE and her ongoing work in NXT. She notably praised rising star Jaida Parker, dubbing her the female Jacob Fatu ahead of their upcoming Submission Match at NXT Heatwave.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown TV ratings and viewership updates
stories.tldr: The August 21, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown on USA Network experienced a slight increase in both viewership and key demographic ratings compared to the previous week. Data shows the show drew 1,280,000 viewers with a 0.32 rating in the 18 to 49 demographic, up from 1,247,000 viewers and a 0.3 rating the week prior. Year-over-year figures showed a 1.7 percent increase in total viewership despite an 8.6 percent drop in the demo compared to the same week in 2025. Additionally, digital engagement remained strong with top YouTube videos drawing hundreds of thousands of views.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano apologizes for accidental injuries caused on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: Recently released wrestling star Zoey Serrano launched a new digital series called Zoey 101 to answer fan questions about her career. During the premiere episode, she addressed two regrettable incidents from her time on WWE Raw where opponents were accidentally injured. Serrano expressed deep remorse for breaking Katana Chance's nose in 2024 and causing a concussion and memory loss for Dakota Kai during a tag team match in January 2025. She emphasized the sacred trust between in-ring performers and apologized profusely to both women for the mishaps.

stories.title: Natalya praises NXT star Jaida Parker
stories.tldr: WWE veteran Natalya recently revealed that she personally requested WWE management to let her work on the NXT brand specifically to feud with rising star Jaida Parker. During a recent interview, Natalya praised Parker's unique intensity and work ethic, even comparing her to Raw star Jacob Fatu by calling her a female version of him. The two competitors are now scheduled to settle their ongoing rivalry in a high-stakes submission match at NXT Heatwave.

stories.title: Logan Paul recovery from triceps injury
stories.tldr: Logan Paul is making significant progress in his recovery from a severe triceps injury sustained earlier this year while wrestling The Street Profits. During a recent visit to Dr. Dugas featured on his YouTube channel, Paul learned that his arm is healing well and he is now considered semi-cleared to resume certain physical activities. He has already taken his updated status backstage to Monday Night Raw, sharing the news with WWE officials including Bruce Prichard and Triple H.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes visits Marvel Studios
stories.tldr: WWE star Cody Rhodes recently shared a photo from inside Marvel Studios on his Instagram Story, sparking widespread speculation among fans about a potential acting role in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. While Rhodes provided no details and neither he nor Marvel has confirmed any casting, fans have already begun fantasy-casting him as various comic book characters including Bastion, William Stryker, Havok, Nova, or a Captain America variant. Rhodes has long expressed a desire to transition into major acting roles similar to fellow wrestling legends Dwayne Johnson, John Cena, and Dave Bautista, having previously auditioned for Black Bolt and expressed interest in playing the X-Men character Cable.

stories.title: Hulk Hogan's WrestleMania 2 championship belt sold at auction
stories.tldr: Hulk Hogan's iconic WWF World Heavyweight Championship belt from WrestleMania 2 recently sold at a Heritage Auctions event for a staggering $414,800. The classic globe-design title was photo-matched to the historic 1986 event, where Hogan successfully defended the championship against King Kong Bundy inside a steel cage. According to auction records, Hogan originally gifted the belt backstage to the son of a close family friend, and it remained in that family's possession for decades before heading to the auction block.

stories.title: Santos Escobar advocates for more Latino writers and producers in WWE
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Santos Escobar, now performing as Romeo Malverde, recently advocated for the promotion to hire more Latino writers and producers to authentically represent Hispanic culture. In an interview with Denise Salcedo, Escobar emphasized that only those within the community truly understand how to approach the valuable Latino demographic. Additionally, Escobar reflected on his brief departure from WWE last year, revealing to TMZ Sports that a personal phone call and apology from Nick Khan regarding his character's direction led directly to his decision to re-sign.

stories.title: New WWE Superstar debuting with unique gimmick
stories.tldr: A new WWE developmental star named Vanta The Unknown is preparing for her televised in-ring debut on WWE Evolve with a striking dark gimmick and facepaint. Portrayed by Russian gymnast and pole dancer Jessica Bogdanov, the character has already been tested at untelevised NXT live events against names like Nikkita Lyons. Her recent promos promise a psychological and intense presence, aiming to stand out from the typical roster naming conventions without leaning too far into supernatural territory.

stories.title: Cruz Montana names retired wrestler as dream opponent
stories.tldr: WWE NXT star Cruz Montana recently revealed that his ultimate dream match would have been against AJ Styles, who retired from in-ring competition at the 2026 Royal Rumble. The two nearly crossed paths during the recent WWE and TNA partnership, but the cross-promotional bout ultimately never came together. In addition to Styles, Montana is eager to step into the ring with active WWE stars like Cody Rhodes and CM Punk, both of whom he previously worked with in AEW. Currently, Montana is focused on his upcoming opportunity as he prepares to challenge for the NXT Championship at NXT Heatwave.

stories.title: Natalya says she wants to train Logan Paul at the Hart Dungeon
stories.tldr: WWE veteran Natalya recently extended an invitation to Logan Paul to train at the famous Hart Dungeon alongside her husband TJ Wilson and other top talent. Speaking with TMZ Inside The Ring, Natalya praised Paul's dedication to the wrestling business, noting his recent efforts to attend shows despite a serious arm injury. She believes that putting him through the rigorous Dungeon training sessions could help him elevate his in-ring skills to the next level. Paul recently provided an update on his recovery, stating he is currently semi-cleared for an in-ring return.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano reveals contract offers from WWE and TNA
stories.tldr: Zoey Serrano, formerly known in WWE as Zoey Stark, recently shared that she received simultaneous contract offers from both WWE and TNA Wrestling early in her career. Although she ultimately chose to sign with WWE in January 2021, she credited her previous television exposure working as Lacey Ryan in TNA for helping her get noticed by WWE scouts. Her career has since featured an NXT Women's Tag Team Championship reign, a main roster run alongside Shayna Baszler, and prominent programs with stars like Trish Stratus and Becky Lynch. Following a knee injury and her subsequent departure from WWE, Serrano recently made her in-ring return at RevPro's Women's Grand Prix.

stories.title: Dawn Marie details past firing from WWE during pregnancy
stories.tldr: Former ECW and WWE star Dawn Marie recently opened up about being abruptly fired by WWE years ago due to her pregnancy, noting she was the first woman under contract to experience this. Despite the lingering trauma and a difficult recent NXT guest referee appearance that brought back old pain, she ultimately found closure from the situation. Today, she has completely transitioned away from wrestling to work as a nurse, run a crystal store, and manage an OnlyFans account to secure her future.

stories.title: Triple H celebrates 50th anniversary of Motörhead
stories.tldr: WWE Chief Content Officer Paul Triple H Levesque recently paid tribute to the legendary rock band Motorhead and his late friend Ian Lemmy Kilmister in honor of the group's 50th anniversary. Taking to social media, Levesque showcased new anniversary merchandise while remembering the band that famously performed his entrance themes at multiple WrestleMania events. The two shared a deep personal and professional bond until Lemmy's passing in 2015, with Lemmy later crediting the wrestling star for introducing their music to a whole new generation of fans.

stories.title: WWE Evolve talent reportedly heading to main roster
stories.tldr: WWE Evolve has emerged as a pre-NXT developmental show streaming weekly on Tubi, serving as a breeding ground for talent that could potentially bypass NXT entirely. Five specific developmental prospects, including Brooks Jensen, Kale Dixon, PJ Vasa, Harlem Lewis, and Elijah Holyfield, have been identified as strong candidates to make the direct jump to the main roster. Factors such as backstage praise, international excursions, unique character styles, and main roster dark matches have positioned these athletes to skip the traditional developmental television route.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman discusses WWE Radio departure
stories.tldr: Jonathan Coachman recently discussed his departure from hosting Off The Ropes after his radio channel was transformed into official WWE Radio. Although he was not given an official reason for the change, Coachman believes losing the role ultimately benefits his credibility. He argued that staying with an officially branded WWE platform would have forced him to praise every creative decision and risk looking like a fraud to fans. Coachman is now focused on building independent programming where he can maintain honest and balanced commentary.

stories.title: Bully Ray discusses potential WWE return for Saturday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Bully Ray recently discussed the high-stakes match between Bron Breakker and Oba Femi, noting the creative dilemma of not wanting either rising star to suffer a loss. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, he suggested that Bronson Reed could interfere in the match to stake his own claim as the true future of WWE while aligning with Paul Heyman. This outside interference would protect both competitors by allowing Breakker to win after a chaotic sequence while shielding Femi with sympathy as a babyface. Bully Ray and co-host Dave LaGreca also explored how Reed would benefit the most from Heyman's management, contrasting him with Breakker and Femi who possess qualities that make managers unnecessary.

stories.title: Santos Escobar confirms he will not reprise El Hijo del Fantasma gimmick
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Romeo Malverde, formerly known as Santos Escobar, has officially stated that he will not bring back his El Hijo del Fantasma persona. He believes in advancing rather than looking backward and is currently taking his time before returning to the active wrestling scene. Alongside preparing for his next chapter in the industry, Malverde is also pursuing various acting opportunities.

stories.title: Roman Reigns sends message ahead of RAW title defense in Mexico City
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns has issued a public challenge on social media ahead of his World Heavyweight Championship defense on September 14 in Mexico City. The upcoming title match will feature the winner of a high-stakes tournament involving top luchadors, which has boiled down to a final match between real-life brothers Penta and Rey Fenix. This tournament has offered a refreshing change of pace for Reigns and his limited schedule, even though a title change appears unlikely given his current overarching storylines with other top stars.

stories.title: Santos Escobar reflects on lessons learned during WWE career
stories.tldr: Former WWE wrestler Jorge Bolly, who performed as Santos Escobar, reflects on the valuable lessons he learned from legendary coaches and peers during his time with the company despite being released following WrestleMania 42. Now competing under the new name Romeo Malverde, he is blending his past experiences as Escobar, El Hijo del Fantasma, and King Cuerno into a more mature and profitable persona. He credits veterans like Shawn Michaels, Triple H, Rey Mysterio, and others for shaping his current wrestling mindset as he prepares for his next career chapter.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman claims ESPN bias against wrestling led to pay cut
stories.tldr: Jonathan Coachman recently discussed his career transition from WWE to ESPN, revealing that institutional bias against professional wrestling severely impacted his earnings. He claims an unnamed network executive who despised his wrestling background forced a sixty thousand dollar yearly salary cut and later slashed his pay by one hundred twenty thousand dollars total on a second deal. That second agreement was negotiated by current WWE President Nick Khan, whom the executive falsely accused Coachman of trash-talking. Coachman now regrets accepting the pay cuts without a fight and views the ordeal as a harsh lesson in self-advocacy.

stories.title: WON Flashback: WWE SummerSlam 2007 review
stories.tldr: This WON flashback reviews WWE SummerSlam 2007, a poorly received event featuring one of the worst matches in PPV history. Dave Meltzer famously gave Batista versus The Great Khali a negative one and a half star rating, highlighted by his sarcastic quip that he liked the finish simply because it meant the match was over. Despite the heavy criticism, fan backlash, and notorious nerve holds, the historic bout has surprisingly accumulated 13 million views on YouTube over the years.

stories.title: WWE NXT TV ratings and viewership updates
stories.tldr: Following the final preparations for Heatwave, the August 18 episode of NXT saw a notable rebound in audience metrics. Wrestlenomics reported that viewership rose to 683,000 viewers with a 0.14 rating in the key 18 to 49 demographic. This marks a significant increase from the previous week's 588,000 viewers and 0.09 demo rating.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano opens up about career and WWE run on Twitter Q&A
stories.tldr: Alongside her previous remarks about being blocked from a Chris Bey benefit, Zoey Serrano has launched a new Twitter and X series called Zoey 101. In the first episode, the former WWE star answered fan questions about wrestling myths, bathroom accidents, and online trolls. She candidly discussed everything from passing gas in the ring to dealing with harsh internet insults.

stories.title: AJ Styles reacts to Ilja Dragunov leaving WWE
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently addressed Ilja Dragunov's departure from WWE on his podcast, admitting he is completely in the dark about the situation despite working for the company. Styles expressed genuine sadness over losing a talent he deeply enjoys watching, echoing the surprise felt by many fans. Meanwhile, speculation continues to grow regarding Dragunov's next move, with analysts heavily anticipating a potential debut in AEW in the near future.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman criticizes lack of WWE house show testing
stories.tldr: Following recent backlash over his Raw segment, Joe Hendry's controversial concert has drawn further criticism from industry veteran Jonathan Coachman. Coachman argued that WWE's heavily reduced house-show schedule deprived talent of a crucial testing ground for creative ideas. He claimed that live event trials would have easily exposed the segment as terrible and led to it being scrapped entirely.

stories.title: TNA Impact TV ratings and viewership drops
stories.tldr: TNA Impact experienced a viewership and ratings decline for the August 20, 2026 episode on AMC, dropping below the 200,000 viewer threshold for the second consecutive week. Total viewership fell to 188,000, while the key 18-49 demographic rating took a steep 50 percent hit down to 0.02. This downward trend arrives despite the episode serving as the final television build for the Lockdown pay-per-view event featuring prominent acts like The Hardys.

stories.title: Drake Maverick returning to the ring for PROGRESS Wrestling
stories.tldr: Rockstar Spud, widely known to WWE fans as Drake Maverick, is scheduled to make a surprising in-ring return for PROGRESS Wrestling after nearly five years away from the squared circle. The 43-year-old, who currently works behind the scenes on the WWE Raw creative team, will wrestle on September 12 in Bournemouth and September 13 in Birmingham as part of the company Odyssey Tour. This marks his first match in 1,769 days, with his last official bout taking place in November 2021 before his release from WWE. PROGRESS Wrestling has also made headlines by booking Malakai Black for multiple matches during the tour and confirming that the promotion was recently acquired by former WWE stars Nikki Cross and Killian Dain.

stories.title: AAA announces contender matches for Ola de Calor
stories.tldr: AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio has announced a high-stakes triple threat match between Jack Cartwheel, Nathan Frazer, and Mini Vikingo for the upcoming Ola de Calor event on August 30, 2026. The winner will immediately become the number one contender for the AAA Latin American Championship, setting up a clash against whoever survives the vacant title four-way match that same night. The stacked card at the Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, also features tag team title action, a major six-man tag, a Reina de Reinas contender gauntlet, and El Carnicero's debut.

stories.title: Bret Hart to receive Lou Thesz Award from Cauliflower Alley Club
stories.tldr: The Cauliflower Alley Club has announced that wrestling legend Bret Hart will receive the prestigious 2026 Lou Thesz Award. Known as the Excellence of Execution, Hart is being recognized for his unmatched in-ring precision, storytelling, and lasting impact on the industry. Adding a special family touch to the milestone, last year's recipient Natalya Neidhart will present the award to him. The presentation will take place during the landmark CAC 60: The Diamond Anniversary Reunion in Las Vegas.

stories.title: Wrestling News Rumor Roundup: Aug. 27, 2026
stories.tldr: This rumor roundup covers major updates ahead of AEW All In at Wembley Stadium, including backstage status reports on Kairi Sane and Thekla, alongside betting odds for the match card. The report also addresses recent discussions regarding a retracted ESPN and WWE story, Tony Khan comments on a potential John Cena and Adam Copeland match, and the strategic reasons behind AEW television overruns. Additionally, indie standout VertVixen has reportedly signed an AEW and Ring of Honor contract.

stories.title: Gail Kim calls out BJ Bethel over retracted WWE-ESPN report
stories.tldr: Gail Kim expressed no sympathy for a fired reporter following the retraction of a fabricated story claiming a major network would not renew its WWE deal. Kim revealed she had previously been the target of the reporter's fabricated articles regarding a supposed interest in joining AEW. The controversy has raised serious questions about editorial oversight and accountability within the publishing platform. This incident highlights a broader pattern of credibility issues that went unchecked until a major corporate denial forced the outlet's hand.

stories.title: After Dark Radio discussing mental health topics
stories.tldr: After Dark Radio hosted by Bryan Alvarez recently featured a special appearance by Dr. Tom Nehmy to discuss several significant mental health and therapeutic topics. The episode focused on Induced After Death Communication as a method for grief healing and explored the mainstream rise of EMDR eye movement therapy. Additionally, the conversation included compelling stories of clients communicating with departed loved ones, making for an engaging and informative broadcast.

stories.title: Dana White reacts to Bella Mir loss on Contender Series
stories.tldr: UFC President Dana White recently confessed to being extremely biased heading into the latest episode of the Contender Series where Bella Mir suffered a shocking defeat against Alex Apodaca. Mir, the daughter of UFC legend Frank Mir and a massive betting favorite, lost via a unanimous decision as Apodaca pulled off a massive upset with +1200 odds to earn a UFC contract. White praised Mir for surviving the deep water despite her lack of experience in that area and noted that this tough loss serves as a valuable learning experience for her budding career.

stories.title: Retro Pro Wrestling History: September 1986
stories.tldr: Karl Stern’s latest DragonKingKarl Show looks back at the major professional wrestling events of September 1986. The episode covers the legal outcome for Chris Adams, who received a slap on the wrist following a criminal case, was stripped of the World Class World title, and subsequently jumped to Bill Watts’ UWF promotion. Meanwhile, World Class crowned a new World champion who made a memorable entrance riding a literal horse, and the World Wrestling Federation significantly expanded its television footprint by debuting two new weekly shows, Superstars and Wrestling Challenge.

stories.title: Top 10 wrestling matches in history on August 26
stories.tldr: August 26 has historically hosted numerous classic professional wrestling matches across global promotions. A 1997 encounter between Hiroshi Hase and Kenta Kobashi holds the number one spot according to Cagematch user ratings. The date also features acclaimed bouts like Shingo Takagi versus Will Ospreay, which earned high praise and a five-star rating from Dave Meltzer. This compilation highlights the diverse array of legendary encounters that have taken place on this specific calendar day.

stories.title: TNA Impact broadcast time and previews
stories.tldr: Tonight's episode of TNA Impact airs live on AMC from the CAA Centre in Brampton, Ontario, featuring the finals of the Knockouts TV Title Tournament between M by Elegance and Jada Stone. The broadcast will also include Bear Bronson going one-on-one against Elijah and an appearance by Indi Hartwell. Global start times have been released for fans tuning in around the world, ranging from prime time in North America to early morning hours internationally.

stories.title: Sherilyn Guerrero provides update on her pro wrestling training
stories.tldr: Sherilyn Guerrero, daughter of the legendary Eddie Guerrero, is actively training for a professional wrestling career and has previously expressed interest in facing Mercedes Mone. In a new interview update, Sherilyn shared that her in-ring debut is approaching and that she is thoroughly enjoying the training process. She also revealed specific moves she plans to use, including her father's iconic Three Amigos and Liv Morgan's ObLIVion finisher.

stories.title: AEW star Austin Gunn drops 'Ass Boy Freestyle' rap track
stories.tldr: AEW star Austin Gunn has released a new four-minute rap track titled Ass Boy Freestyle, which embraces the infamous chant originally directed at him and his brother Colten. The song features numerous pro wrestling references, including nods to Eddie Guerrero, Daniel Garcia, and Kenny Omega. Gunn concludes the track by taking a direct shot at fellow wrestlers who pursue music side projects, telling them they are better off being sports entertainers.

stories.title: Report: The Young Bucks could be on final AEW contract of their career
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Radio reports suggest that Matt and Nick Jackson, known as The Young Bucks, may be working on the final active contracts of their professional wrestling careers. According to Dave Meltzer, Matt Jackson is in his forties and has previously considered stepping away from the ring, while both brothers are financially set for life after making substantial money in the industry. Although Kenny Omega is expected to wrestle as long as his body allows and Hangman Adam Page has many years ahead of him due to his younger age, the future of The Elite beyond their current AEW deals remains uncertain. Meanwhile, the duo remains active at the top of the division and is scheduled to challenge for the AEW World Tag Team Championships.

stories.title: Will Ospreay talks low money offer in 2016 WWE contract
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay recently revealed that WWE offered him terrible money to participate in the 2016 Cruiserweight Classic. At the time, Ospreay was already making more money working with New Japan Pro Wrestling, prompting him to pass on the opportunity. Speaking in an interview, the current star also explained that WWE presentation and style never appealed to him compared to promotions like TNA, NOAH, and Dragon Gate. Ospreay noted that while signing with WWE could have eventually led to a larger payday, he has simply never been a WWE guy.

stories.title: Will Ospreay recalls witnessing CM Punk-Jack Perry altercation at AEW All In 2023
stories.tldr: During a recent interview with Ariel Helwani, Will Ospreay recalled having a front row seat to the infamous backstage altercation between CM Punk and Jack Perry at AEW All In 2023 at Wembley Stadium. Ospreay, who was preparing for his match against Chris Jericho at the time, initially mistook the commotion for a backstage promo before realizing what actually occurred. The incident, which happened just before Punk's opening match against Samoa Joe, ultimately resulted in Punk's termination from the company and a suspension for Perry.

stories.title: Will Ospreay explains why he was never a WWE fan and rejected signing
stories.tldr: AEW star Will Ospreay recently explained on the Ariel Helwani Show why he never grew up as a WWE fan and ultimately rejected an offer from the company to sign with AEW instead. He cited his dislike of WWE's presentation, filming style, and minimalistic in-ring approach, preferring instead the high-flying and full-contact styles of TNA's X-Division, Pro Wrestling NOAH, Dragon Gate, and New Japan Pro-Wrestling. Ospreay also noted that WWE's offer required him to move to the United States, a relocation he had no ambition to make, whereas AEW offers him creative freedom with bullet points rather than strict scripts.

stories.title: Chris Jericho discusses getting a new role in 'Margo's Got Money Troubles'
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho originally auditioned for the role of Jinx in the series Margo's Got Money Troubles but failed to land the part. Impressed by his audition, producers created a brand new custom scene and wrote Jericho into the show as himself. Despite initial hesitation about playing himself and wrestling on screen, the involvement of A-list stars like Nicole Kidman and Elle Fanning quickly convinced him to sign on. The resulting two-minute scene established a fictional backstory between Jericho and Jinx, opening doors for potential future appearances and additional Hollywood opportunities.

stories.title: Will Ospreay criticizes WWE strike execution
stories.tldr: During a recent interview with Ariel Helwani, AEW star Will Ospreay discussed why he turned down a 2024 WWE offer, citing relocation issues and creative differences. Ospreay criticized WWE's in-ring style as minimalistic and called out performers for visibly missing strikes on television. Preferring a full-contact style, Ospreay stated he would rather take a real hit than participate in action that looks fake, though he maintains respect for the company's overall success.

stories.title: Chris Jericho praises Kenny Omega as modern era's best big-show performer
stories.tldr: Former World Champion Chris Jericho recently heaped massive praise on AEW executive and World Champion Kenny Omega. Speaking in an interview, Jericho labeled Omega as the modern era's absolute best big-show performer, comparing his consistency to wrestling legend Shawn Michaels. Omega now prepares to defend his AEW World title against Will Ospreay at the upcoming AEW All In 2026 event in London.

stories.title: Cardblade returns on AEW Spill The Tea show
stories.tldr: Cardblade made its triumphant return to All Elite Wrestling programming on a recent episode of the digital series Spill The Tea. Host Rachel Bonnetta welcomed members of the Bang Bang Gang, including Austin Gunn, Colten Gunn, Juice Robinson, and Ace Austin, though Jay White himself was absent. The iconic cardboard cutout reappeared for the first time since July 2025 to join the chaotic tea party segment. Fans were reminded of the groups penchant for cardboard replicas, which previously expanded to include RockCard JuiceBoard and Fully Carded Colten Gunn.

stories.title: Athena reflects on long ROH Women's World Championship reign
stories.tldr: Ring of Honor Women's World Champion Athena recently reflected on her historic title reign spanning over 1,300 days during a media scrum. She explained that her moniker of Forever Champion represents a lifestyle of discipline, motivation, and resilience through severe physical injuries. Despite her unprecedented dominance in Ring of Honor, Athena now has her sights set on expanding her legacy into All Elite Wrestling. She ultimately aims to capture AEW gold while continuing to conquer both promotions.

stories.title: Will Ospreay sets ticket sale goal for AEW All In 2026
stories.tldr: As AEW All In 2026 approaches at Wembley Stadium, main eventer Will Ospreay has set a personal mission to push ticket sales past the 50,000 mark through a heavy media tour. Current tracking data shows distributed tickets sitting just above 42,000, with new sections recently opened to accommodate ongoing demand. Meanwhile, several additional high-stakes matches have been confirmed to round out Sunday's stacked pay-per-view lineup.

stories.title: Eddie Kingston challenging for CMLL World Heavyweight Championship
stories.tldr: Eddie Kingston is set to make his CMLL debut on August 28, 2026, challenging Hechicero for the World Heavyweight Championship at Arena Mexico. This booking confirms his medical clearance following a recent scare that forced him out of an AEW match against Claudio Castagnoli. The upcoming event features a stacked card, including a women's six-man tag team match and a tag team title contendership bout.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Glasgow ticket sales update
stories.tldr: While some domestic dates face sluggish numbers, AEW is heading overseas to a booming market for its final stop before Sunday's mega-event. The Glasgow go-home edition of Dynamite has distributed over 6,200 tickets, nearly doubling the promotion's year-to-date average. A stacked match card featuring multiple tournament semifinals and high-profile appearances is set to cap off the week's London buildup.

stories.title: WWE NXT Episode Reviews, Match Cards, and Heatwave Updates (Aug 25, 2026)
stories.tldr: The final WWE NXT before this weekend's Heatwave event featured a weaponized steel cage opener, a AAA Cruiserweight title defense, and the final setup for a stacked pay-per-view card. Reviewers praised standout moments like Rey Fenix versus EK Prosper and the Nattie-Jaida Parker feud, while criticizing the opening match placement and the flat closing summit. Heatwave takes place this Sunday, August 30, 2026, from Edinburg, Texas, airing live on The CW and Netflix.

stories.title: Nattie vs. Jaida Parker Submission Match added to NXT Heatwave
stories.tldr: Nattie and Jaida Parker will finally settle their intense summer-long feud in a high-stakes submission match at WWE NXT Heatwave on August 30, 2026. The two rivals are currently deadlocked at one win apiece following a tense in-ring confrontation on the August 25 episode of NXT where Nattie called Parker wasted potential. Parker quickly accepted the challenge to prove herself, setting up the first submission match of her career. This grudge match joins a stacked card in Edinburg, Texas, which also features Tony D'Angelo defending the NXT Championship in a fatal four-way and Kendal Grey defending the NXT Women's Championship against Kelani Jordan.

stories.title: John Cena draws wrestling parallels to Coyote vs. Acme and early Hollywood career
stories.tldr: John Cena recently reflected on his acting career and his upcoming role in Coyote vs. Acme, drawing distinct parallels between the film's fan-driven comeback and classic wrestling underdog stories. Speaking on various platforms, Cena admitted his early films lacked passion because he preferred performing in front of live WWE crowds. He also compared his toughest historical opponents, like The Undertaker and Brock Lesnar, to the relentless cartoon dynamic of Wile E. Coyote and the Roadrunner.

stories.title: ESPN denies report about ending WWE Premium Live Event partnership
stories.tldr: ESPN has forcefully denied a recent report claiming the network has already decided not to renew its five-year WWE Premium Live Event partnership when it expires in 2030. The initial report alleged that challenges in the media marketplace, cultural synergy issues, and provider complications led to the supposed early decision to walk away. However, an ESPN spokesperson dismissed the claim as completely false, noting that the network was never contacted for comment prior to publication. With the multi billion dollar deal only about a year into its run since beginning in September 2025, future negotiations will depend on how the partnership performs over the remaining years.

stories.title: Backstage update on AJ Lee's future in WWE post-WrestleMania
stories.tldr: AJ Lee has been away from WWE television since losing the Women's Intercontinental Championship to Becky Lynch at WrestleMania 42, but backstage sources believe she has not wrestled her final match. Despite fan speculation tying her to the recent feud between Paige and the Bella Twins following SummerSlam, creative sources confirmed there were never any plans for her to join that storyline. While she currently has no return date or active creative booking, her previous run was not framed as a retirement, and she has previously expressed openness to future matches against WWE stars like Rhea Ripley, Liv Morgan, Roxanne Perez, Stephanie Vaquer, and Lyra Valkyria.

stories.title: The Rock advertised for WWE tryouts and events in Hawaii
stories.tldr: WWE has updated its promotional material for an upcoming tour and talent tryouts in Honolulu, Hawaii, adding Dwayne The Rock Johnson to graphics that already featured Roman Reigns and The Usos. The tryouts and live events are scheduled for October 16 and 17 at the Blaisdell Arena, with applications closing on September 15. Although WWE has not officially confirmed whether Johnson will make a live appearance or attend in an executive and ambassadorial capacity as a TKO board member, the teaser has sparked significant fan speculation. The Rock has not appeared on WWE television since the Elimination Chamber event in 2025, where he was the catalyst for John Cena's memorable heel turn.

stories.title: Nunzio/Little Guido reflects on WWE career, Brock Lesnar segment, and refereeing stint
stories.tldr: Former ECW star Little Guido recently appeared on the Insight with Chris Van Vliet podcast to reflect on his professional wrestling career, including how Paul Heyman helped him secure a WWE job and created his Nunzio ring name. He shared memorable moments from his time with the company, such as performing at WrestleMania 20, taking a Last Ride from The Undertaker, and slapping Brock Lesnar during a 2003 segment that ended with Chuck Palumbo accidentally crashing a forklift into a building wall. Nunzio also detailed his unexpected one-year stint as a WWE referee, which began when he was the only official able to make it to Madison Square Garden during a heavy snowstorm in December 2010.

stories.title: Kali Armstrong earns spot in NXT Heatwave Title Unification match
stories.tldr: Kali Armstrong defeated NXT Women’s North American Champion ZARIA on the August 25 episode of NXT to earn a coveted spot in the upcoming title unification match at NXT Heatwave. Originally scheduled as a one-on-one bout between ZARIA and WWE Women’s Speed Champion Wren Sinclair, the stipulation set by General Manager Robert Stone added Armstrong to the mix following her hard-fought pinfall victory. As a result, the August 30 Premium Live Event will now feature a high-stakes Triple Threat match where the winner leaves holding both unified championships.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton and Zelina Vega teach streamer Cinna how to wrestle
stories.tldr: Popular Twitch streamer Cinna recently hosted a wild outdoor wrestling stream featuring Zelina Vega, who also goes by Xelina, and WWE star Tiffany Stratton. What began as a lesson in basic wrestling moves quickly escalated when Vega started roughing up the streamer inside the ring. Fortunately, Stratton intervened on Cinna's behalf, taking down Vega with a clothesline and a dropkick to save the day.

stories.title: Shiloh Hill vs. Naraku set for September 1 WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Shiloh Hill and Naraku are officially set to collide on the September 1 episode of WWE NXT. The grudge match stems from the August 18 broadcast, where Naraku interfered in Hill's number one contender's match against Jackson Drake by spraying mist in his face. This costly attack robbed Hill of his opportunity to compete for the North American Championship at Heatwave. Following a successful backstage confrontation with General Manager Robert Stone, Hill has secured his chance at ultimate revenge.

stories.title: CM Punk explains why he wrestled at WWE NXT live event
stories.tldr: WWE Champion CM Punk recently explained his surprise appearance at an August 15 NXT live event in Petersburg, Virginia, where he teamed with Tavion Heights and Myles Borne to defeat The Vanity Project. In a behind-the-scenes WWE vlog, Punk admitted to a selfish desire to stay ready and get more in-ring reps, alongside a genuine goal to give back to the next generation of talent. Highlighting backstage interactions and high praise for the roster's future, Punk confirmed that he had fun and vowed to return to the brand in the future.

stories.title: Bianca Belair gives update on carpal tunnel syndrome post-pregnancy
stories.tldr: Former WWE champion Bianca Belair has provided a candid health update following the birth of her son, Romeo Leonardo Allen Crawford, with husband Montez Ford earlier this month. Alongside common post-pregnancy conditions like carpal tunnel syndrome in both hands and mom thumb, she continues to deal with lingering complications from a finger injury sustained during a WrestleMania 41 triple threat match against Rhea Ripley and IYO SKY. Belair noted a complete lack of feeling in the finger that required surgery in February 2026, alongside a total loss of grip strength. While her ongoing maternity leave provides extended recovery time, there is currently no official timetable for her return to the ring.

stories.title: The Rock unlikely to wrestle at WWE WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia due to schedule
stories.tldr: The Rock is reportedly unlikely to wrestle at WWE WrestleMania 43 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, due to his upcoming Hollywood commitments. Although local organizers are heavily interested in securing a match for him and could offer a massive financial package, his scheduled filming for the final Fast and Furious movie starting in December leaves virtually no time for the rigorous training he requires. Wrestling observers note that while an in-ring match is likely out of the question, a non-wrestling appearance in Saudi Arabia remains a distinct possibility.

stories.title: Richard Holliday teases potential WWE NXT debut at Heatwave
stories.tldr: Independent wrestling free agent Richard Holliday has fueled intense speculation about a potential WWE NXT debut at this weekend's Heatwave event. The rumors follow his recent dramatic departure from Game Changer Wrestling, where he left his boots in the ring after a match against Bear Bronson. Holliday recently took to social media to announce he will address his future over the weekend, aligning with the timing of NXT Heatwave in Edinburgh, Texas. Sources previously indicated that WWE has strong interest in Holliday following his tryout earlier this year and backstage appearances at NXT tapings.

stories.title: Shareholder lawsuit settlement holdup involving WWE and TKO resolved
stories.tldr: A major hurdle delaying the finalization of a massive 147.5 million dollar WWE shareholder lawsuit settlement has nearly been cleared. The delay stemmed from a narrow disagreement between attorneys for Vince McMahon and representatives for current and former executives including Nick Khan, Paul Levesque, George Barrios, and Michelle Wilson regarding payment responsibilities and insurance coverage. Court filings submitted to the Delaware Court of Chancery indicate that these intra-defendant release issues have now been addressed. The parties are merely awaiting final signoff from non-party insurance carriers before officially executing the settlement papers.

stories.title: F4W Daily Update and Big Vinny V on Lola Vice on RAW
stories.tldr: NXT standout Lola Vice is officially making the jump to the WWE Monday Night Raw roster, with a recent video package teasing her debut for September 14 in Mexico City. Vinny V highlights her remarkable four-year evolution from an MMA fighter in Bellator to a decorated, versatile champion capable of handling WWE style wrestling, lucha libre, and shoot-style matches. Additionally, recent wrestling updates cover a wide array of industry news including TKO settlement developments, Netflix viewership milestones, and various promotional notes from NXT, AEW, and ROH.

stories.title: WWE broadcast rights ending on Japanese streaming service ABEMA
stories.tldr: Japanese streaming service ABEMA has announced that its broadcast rights deal with WWE will officially end on September 30, 2026. After a three-year partnership carrying Raw, SmackDown, and Premium Live Events, ABEMA's final broadcast will be the September 29 episode of Raw. The impending departure is widely expected to precede a move to Netflix in Japan, aligning with WWE's broader international distribution strategy. Meanwhile, ABEMA's parent company CyberAgent recently acquired a significant stake in New Japan Pro-Wrestling, further intertwining its corporate footprint in the Japanese pro wrestling landscape.

stories.title: AJ Styles producing matches in WWE NXT
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer AJ Styles revealed on his show that he expects to produce the upcoming NXT Championship fatal four-way match at NXT Heatwave. The high-profile bout will feature champion Tony D'Angelo defending against Grayson Waller, Cruz Montana, and Zilla Fatu. Styles also shared that he previously advocated for main roster talent to work in NXT even when Vince McMahon was running creative, believing the crossover greatly benefits developmental talent.

stories.title: Sol Ruca praises WWE women's locker room environment
stories.tldr: WWE star Sol Ruca recently praised the current atmosphere within the women's locker room, describing it as an extremely healthy and collaborative environment. Contrasting with the notoriously competitive backstage reputations of past generations, Ruca noted that today's female talent actively helps one another brainstorm ideas and craft seamless pitches. Ultimately, she emphasized that the roster shares a unified drive to deliver top-tier performances and prove that the women can match or even outperform the men.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff on how WWE can recreate a Goldberg-style undefeated streak
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff believes WWE can successfully recreate a Goldberg-style undefeated streak if they wait for the right moment and talent. Speaking on his podcast, Bischoff explained that authenticity and organic growth are crucial to avoiding a forced copycat feel. He also noted that WCW succeeded with Goldberg by hiding his early in-ring limitations and keeping his matches short, simple, and explosive.

stories.title: WWE confirms championship match lineup change
stories.tldr: WWE has officially confirmed a major lineup change for the upcoming NXT Heatwave premium live event taking place on Sunday, August 30, at the Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas. Following a high-stakes match on the August 25 episode of NXT, Kali Armstrong defeated Zaria to successfully insert herself into the previously announced title unification match. Consequently, Heatwave will now feature a triple threat match between Zaria, Wren Sinclair, and Kali Armstrong, with both the NXT Women's North American Championship and Women's Speed Championship on the line.

stories.title: Saquon Shugars vs. Dion Lennox Weaponized Steel Cage match result on NXT
stories.tldr: Saquon Shugars defeated Dion Lennox in a brutal Weaponized Steel Cage match on the go-home show for NXT Heatwave, finally settling months of bad blood. The bitter rivalry originated from Lennox betraying Shugars, a former DarkState stablemate, which sparked a series of violent attacks. Despite suffering a knee injury during a top-rope powerbomb attempt, Shugars fought through the pain to hit a decisive superkick and a massive crossbody from the top of the cage to secure the victory.

stories.title: Rey Fenix retains AAA Cruiserweight Title in WWE NXT match
stories.tldr: Rey Fenix successfully defended his AAA World Cruiserweight Championship against EK Prosper on a recent episode of WWE NXT. Prosper earned the title opportunity by winning a fatal four-way match the previous week. After a high-paced back-and-forth battle featuring near falls and high-flying maneuvers, Fenix ultimately secured the victory with a Mexican Muscle Buster.

stories.title: Former Evolve Champion Aaron Rourke returning to WWE Evolve
stories.tldr: Former Evolve Men's Champion Aaron Rourke is officially returning to WWE Evolve on the August 26, 2026 episode after a multi-week absence. Announced by WWE ID as both a former titleholder and a current prospect, Rourke expressed excitement about bringing his Sparkle City persona back to the Wednesday night show streaming on Tubi. Although WWE has not yet revealed his opponent or specific plans, his return sets the stage for a potential pursuit of current champion Harlem Lewis or the start of a brand new storyline.

stories.title: Scott Vick opens up about Katie Vick WWE angle and Triple H
stories.tldr: Former WCW star Scott Vick, better known as Sick Boy from Raven’s Flock, recently broke his long-standing absence from social media to address his brief and bizarre WWE run. In an exclusive interview with the Wrestling Epicenter, Vick discussed how he was abruptly called out of semi-retirement while eating dinner at Pizza Hut to play the fictional brother of the infamous Katie Vick. He shed light on the backstage politics of the notorious storyline involving Triple H and Kane, noting that he was brought in at the very end of his WWE tenure just to cut a single promo comparing the tragedy to Chappaquiddick.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff criticizes WWE's presentation of Roman Reigns & Cody Rhodes at Fanatics Fest
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff and Conrad Thompson recently criticized WWE on the 83 Weeks podcast for placing top stars Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes in awkward athletic challenges during Fanatics Fest. They argued that letting these wrestlers fail at simple tasks like kicking field goals or shooting hoops damages their superhuman, larger-than-life aura. Bischoff compared this unfavorably to Vince McMahon's strict protection of stars like Hulk Hogan and Stone Cold Steve Austin, ultimately blaming corporate marketers who lack a fundamental understanding of the wrestling business.

stories.title: John Cena recalls almost getting cut by WWE early in his career
stories.tldr: John Cena recently revealed on Conan O Brien Needs A Friend that he was nearly fired during his early days in WWE after appearing on a December roster cuts list in 2000 or 2001. Saved by an impromptu freestyle rap session on a tour bus that caught the attention of the head of creative, Cena transitioned into the Doctor of Thuganomics and eventually became a 17-time World Champion. Cena also discussed his retirement in December 2025 following a match against Gunther, confirming he is done wrestling physically but remains involved with his WWE family as he continues to evolve his role.

stories.title: Trish Stratus names WWE star who deserves more spotlight
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus recently expressed her belief that veteran wrestler Candice LeRae deserves a much bigger spotlight in the company. During an interview, Stratus praised LeRae's talent and highlighted their past match together, noting that LeRae's extensive experience makes her a standout performer. Despite joining WWE eight years ago and achieving milestones like winning tag team and speed championships, LeRae has often struggled for consistent television time.

stories.title: WWE Raw on Netflix reaches highest viewership since May
stories.tldr: WWE Raw on Netflix experienced a notable boost in viewership for the August 17, 2026 episode, reaching 2.7 million global views. This marks the highest viewership for the program in nearly four months, tying the numbers achieved on the May 4 broadcast. Both total views and global hours watched surpassed their rolling ten-week averages. The strong showing was bolstered by high-profile segments including The Usos and Roman Reigns, alongside an Intercontinental Championship match.

stories.title: Overview of new free agent signings debuting in WWE
stories.tldr: WWE is heavily rumored to bring in several new free agents following recent high-profile debuts like Kyoki, Cruz Montana, and Zilla Fatu. Names heavily linked to the company include independent veteran Richard Holliday, former NXT star Mara Sade, and TNA's Eric Young. Additionally, contract situations and recent developments have sparked speculation regarding potential future WWE arrivals for AEW's Max Caster and TNA standout Leon Slater.

stories.title: Zoey Stark reveals WWE denied request to appear at Chris Bey benefit show
stories.tldr: Zoey Serrano, formerly known as Zoey Stark in WWE, recently revealed that she requested permission from the company to appear at a benefit show for injured wrestler Chris Bey. Although she ultimately did not receive a response, Serrano believes the request was likely denied due to a conflicting WWE touring schedule. She expressed her continued friendship and admiration for Bey, who is currently recovering from a severe neck injury sustained during a TNA taping.

stories.title: Road Dogg recalls wild incident with Jeff Jarrett on cocaine binge
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Road Dogg recently shared a wild and harrowing story from his past partying days involving fellow wrestling star Jeff Jarrett. During an appearance at FAN Expo Chicago 2026, Road Dogg recalled how the two men encountered a dead body in the road while leaving a local nightclub after an eight-hour cocaine binge. Due to their heavily altered state at the time, they made the controversial decision to drive right past the scene instead of stopping to assist. Road Dogg has frequently been candid about his historical struggles with substance abuse, openly acknowledging that he made many regrettable choices during that era of his life.

stories.title: Former WWE star spotted backstage at live event with CM Punk
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Davey Boy Smith Jr. was spotted backstage at a recent WWE live event in his hometown of Calgary, Alberta, Canada. During his visit, the second-generation wrestler caught up with old acquaintances and posed for photos with Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk. Smith later shared his appreciation on social media, recalling his history of working alongside and against Punk in the past. He further fueled speculation about a potential comeback to the company by teasing that they might cross paths in the ring again someday.

stories.title: WON Flashback: Is WWE SummerSlam 2002 the best SummerSlam ever?
stories.tldr: August 25, 2002 marked the date of WWE SummerSlam, an event frequently cited by fans and historians as one of the greatest pay-per-views in company history. The historic card featured incredible matches ranging from a stellar opening sprint between Kurt Angle and Rey Mysterio to Shawn Michaels facing Triple H in an unsanctioned street fight. Furthermore, the night solidified Brock Lesnar as the company's new megastar by defeating The Rock for the WWE Undisputed Championship. Wrestling historians later praised the event's booking, hype, and long-term planning for successfully turning Lesnar into a marquee attraction.

stories.title: Royce Keys and OTM debut on WWE RAW with new alliance
stories.tldr: Following their shocking main roster debut alongside Royce Keys on Monday Night Raw, backstage reports indicate that WWE had been planning the new faction for several weeks. However, timeline clues suggest a late pivot by the company, given that Bronco Nima had just finished a brief stint in AAA and tension was recently teased between the OTM members in NXT. Both Nima and Price have since reacted to their call-up online, while their long-term trajectory and alignment alongside Keys remain to be determined.

stories.title: Shinsuke Nakamura and Kyoki (Hiromu Takahashi) team name revealed
stories.tldr: Shinsuke Nakamura and Kyoki have reportedly been given the official tag team name Bakusai, which translates to blasting to pieces. The moniker stems from a recent WWE trademark filing and was prominently featured on the titantron during Kyoki's recent dark match entrance. The newly formed duo is already setting their sights on the SmackDown tag team division, targeting current champions The MFTs.

stories.title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event match card updates and potential debuts
stories.tldr: Additional matches and high-profile segments are currently being discussed for the upcoming Sunday Night's Main Event card in Atlanta. Creative has floated a potential in-ring main roster debut for Blake Monroe against Giulia, alongside multi-person tag matches and championship contender bouts. As the September 6 event approaches, the finalized lineup is expanding beyond the previously announced marquee clashes.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu responds to 'Nepo Baby' comments and wrecks rivals on NXT
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu responded to his critics and rivals during a fiery promo on NXT, rejecting labels about his fast-tracked success. He addressed Grayson Waller's ongoing mockery by defending his work ethic and pointing to his massive social media reach. Fatu then backed up his words by wiping out his championship opponents during a chaotic summit to close the show. He now heads into his debut title match this weekend holding all the momentum.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer speculates on Ilja Dragunov's post-WWE free agency
stories.tldr: Ilja Dragunov is officially a free agent following the expiration of his WWE contract. AEW President Tony Khan has fueled speculation with repeated, high-praise comments about the former champion in recent interviews. Industry analysts now predict that AEW will make a substantial offer to secure his services. Furthermore, because his contract naturally expired rather than ending in a release, Dragunov is free to debut immediately, sparking rumors of a potential surprise appearance at upcoming events in the UK.

stories.title: Report on released WWE stars making returns to company
stories.tldr: Expanding on the trend of WWE bringing back former talent, analysts have highlighted five recent departures as prime candidates for future returns. The list includes high-profile names like Sheamus and Ilja Dragunov, alongside developmental veterans like Shayna Baszler and Cora Jade. Each star brings unique circumstances, ranging from contract disputes to rebuilding momentum in other promotions.

stories.title: Preview and speculation for WWE Money In The Bank 2026
stories.tldr: With Money in the Bank moving to October, speculation has highlighted six potential winners for this year men's ladder match. Names like Bron Breakker, Sami Zayn, and LA Knight are positioning themselves into the world title conversation. Meanwhile, rising stars like Trick Williams and Dominik Mysterio are also being evaluated for a potential main event breakthrough.

stories.title: Bully Ray speculates on Cody Rhodes & Paul Heyman alliance
stories.tldr: Hall of Famer Bully Ray believes Cody Rhodes recently hinted at a future alliance with Paul Heyman during a SmackDown promo. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, Ray argued that if this leads to a heel turn, WWE must execute it with the historical magnitude of Hulk Hogan forming the nWo. He emphasized that the angle leaves zero room for error and would require a carefully chosen beloved babyface for Rhodes to betray.

stories.title: Roman Reigns limited WWE match schedule for rest of 2026
stories.tldr: World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns will work a limited schedule for the remainder of 2026, but WWE has mapped out a massive slate of opponents for the Tribal Chief. He is scheduled to defend his title against either Penta or Rey Fenix in Mexico City, face LA Knight at Money in the Bank, and battle CM Punk at Crown Jewel. Additional programs with Solo Sikoa, Royce Keys, and a potential Survivor Series War Games match are also on the horizon.

stories.title: WWE figure compares new RAW faction debut to Shield and Nexus
stories.tldr: Royce Keys made a shocking return on Monday Night Raw alongside NXT call-ups Bronco Nima and Lucien Price to brutally lay waste to the main event scene. WWE analyst Sam Roberts later compared the chaotic, unaligned debut to a mix of The Shield and The Nexus. The newly debuted tag team has since reacted to their arrival on social media as the trio positions themselves for a potential clash with the Bloodline.

stories.title: Giulia WWE status and booking direction after SmackDown loss
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe ambushed Giulia before their scheduled SmackDown match, preventing Monroe from making her official in-ring debut. Following the unprovoked attack, Giulia vowed to retaliate in a post-show interview, setting up an ongoing feud between the two competitors. Meanwhile, wrestling veterans Bully Ray and AJ Styles have weighed in on Giulia's main roster momentum, with Ray suggesting potential character tweaks or an NXT return, while Styles urged patience regarding her booking trajectory.

stories.title: Composer Jim Johnston says chances of working with WWE again are close to zero
stories.tldr: Legendary WWE composer Jim Johnston has clarified that the likelihood of him returning to the company is virtually nonexistent, despite his personal willingness to do so. Appearing on the All Axxess Podcast, Johnston explained that he expects no outreach from Triple H, the WWE Music Group, or the company's current head composer. Furthermore, he criticized modern wrestling themes as generic noise that lacks the instant recognizability of his classic work.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez WWE Raw August 24 subscriber report
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez has officially released his subscriber-exclusive evaluation covering the August 24 episode of Monday Night Raw. The new report delves deeper into the fallout from the broadcast and the overall creative direction of the show. Subscribers can now access the full analysis for a complete breakdown of the latest events.

stories.title: AJ Francis calls himself the LeBron James of pro wrestling
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling star AJ Francis recently declared himself the LeBron James of professional wrestling during an interview with MuscleManMalcolm. Standing at 6-foot-5 and 300 pounds, the former NFL player pointed to his unique blend of size and agility, noting his ability to perform high-flying maneuvers like second-rope moonsaults and carry over 700 pounds of multiple opponents. Francis also argued that his extensive work elevating and putting over talent across the industry mirrors LeBron James' legendary playmaking and assist-heavy style on the basketball court.

stories.title: Wrestling legends and stars tribute country music icon Dolly Parton
stories.tldr: Country music legend Dolly Parton passed away peacefully in Nashville at the age of 80, prompting an outpouring of emotional tributes from across the professional wrestling industry. Figures like Ric Flair, Mickie James, Nick Aldis, and Linda McMahon shared their admiration for her monumental career as a singer, businesswoman, and philanthropist. Additionally, wrestling veterans like Ricky Morton shared touching personal childhood memories of growing up near Parton in Tennessee.

stories.title: MVP criticizes TNA management for gross mismanagement driving talent away
stories.tldr: During a recent episode of his podcast, current AEW star MVP opened up about his time in TNA Wrestling, blaming the company's historical decline on gross mismanagement and unqualified personnel. He specifically criticized former executive John Gaburick and discussed how backstage incidents involving an intoxicated Gaburick drove top stars like Samoa Joe and Bobby Roode to quit. MVP also pointed to a major missed opportunity when Spike TV reportedly considered buying the promotion years ago but balked at Dixie Carter's involvement and Vince Russo's creative direction.

stories.title: The Bryan & Vinny Show: Zoom Crashout, Mid-South Oct 1984, and Daily Wrestling Topics
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez and Vinny ​Roades returned for a new episode of their audio show despite suffering yet another frustrating technical failure on Zoom, which also plagued a separate episode of Wrestling Observer Live hosted by Bryan and Filthy Tom Lawlor. During the flagship show, the hosts engaged in their weekly guilt-ridden chat with Granny—who delivered her usual soap opera and wrestling reports, played trivia, and threatened violence against Bryan—before reviewing an episode of Mid-South Wrestling from October 1984. Meanwhile, the companion Wrestling Observer Live broadcast covered Tom Lawlor nearly injuring himself with a chain during a match, ticket sales updates for Wembley and Dynamite, the major WWE and ESPN story making headlines, and a review of Monday Night Raw.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth thanks WWE star for helping transition to independent scene
stories.tldr: After leaving WWE in September 2023, Nic Nemeth transitioned into the independent wrestling circuit for the first time in his 20-year career. To help navigate this unfamiliar landscape, Nemeth turned to former WWE colleague Matt Cardona, who previously mastered the free agency market and reinvented himself on the indie scene. Nemeth praised Cardona as the blueprint for success, crediting him with essential advice on merchandise and independent operations. Since making the jump, Nemeth has successfully captured championship gold both domestically and internationally.

stories.title: Chris Jericho discussed potential Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling debut
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho recently revealed that he was in talks to appear at the upcoming Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling Northern Rising pay-per-view event. A scheduling conflict ultimately prevented the Canadian wrestling legend from joining the October 3 card at the historic Mattamy Athletic Centre. While Adam Copeland is still set to make his promotional debut on the show, Jericho expressed a strong desire to work with Scott D'Amore and MLP in the future. He praised the company for being a Canadian promotion operated by someone who is smart to the business and operating for the right reasons.

stories.title: Sorgstock live wrestling event set for Bethel, New York
stories.tldr: This Friday, the historic grounds of Bethel, New York, will host Sorgstock, a live wrestling event celebrating the monumental contributions of Pittsburgh video producer Mike Sorg. While Pittsburgh has a rich wrestling history dating back to Bruno Sammartino, Shane Douglas, and Kurt Angle, much of the city is early independent tape library was lost to time due to the high costs of analog production. Through Sorgatron Media, Mike Sorg and his team have revolutionized the region by recording, producing, and livestreaming a modern generation of local grapplers. The upcoming event serves as a tribute to Sorg's decade-plus dedication to preserving and promoting the Steel City independent wrestling scene.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny & Craig recap TNA Lockdown and AAA coverage
stories.tldr: Vince Verhei breaks down the chaotic aftermath of TNA Lockdown and recent AAA events on the Big Vinny V Show. He questions the confusing booking decisions at TNA Lockdown, including the heavy interference and humiliating babyface losses in the all-cage match gimmick. Additionally, he highlights a bizarre AAA tournament match where neither the advertised competitors nor the actual participants matched who supposedly advanced.

stories.title: JBL comments on Avery Styles controversy prior to TNA signing
stories.tldr: Following his recent TNA signing and upcoming independent debut, Avery Styles has found himself at the center of an online controversy. The discourse stems from an incident where the young wrestler was allegedly asked to help set up an independent show before his match. WWE Hall of Famer JBL has now weighed in on the situation, criticizing the decision to air the dispute publicly and discussing the traditional expectations of paying dues in the wrestling business.

stories.title: Top 10 pro wrestling matches in history on August 25
stories.tldr: Following yesterday's look at historic title changes, attention now turns to the top 10 matches that took place on August 25 across various promotions. Cagematch ratings and Wrestling Observer Newsletter star ratings highlight legendary bouts, topped by Bryan Danielson defeating Swerve Strickland for the AEW title in 2024. Dave Meltzer's detailed review of that 5.25-star main event captures the dramatic, hard-hitting title change.

stories.title: Historical pro wrestling title changes on August 25
stories.tldr: Shifting to the calendar date of August 25, the wrestling archives log roughly 252 notable championship changes over the decades. Key historical milestones on this date feature iconic victories from legends like Sting, Brock Lesnar, and Mickie James. More recent additions to the history books include major title shifts in AAA and Hook capturing the FTW World Heavyweight Title in 2024.
